experiment: E12, the push estimated from yes-or-no answers

Y1.rule: with 50 judgments the share kept with yes-or-no answers is lower than with the graded cue in at least 80% of the units

Y2.rule: judgments needed to keep 90% of the gain, yes-or-no over graded, median over the units, within [3.0, 9.0]; a unit that never reaches it counts as outside

Y3.rule: with 100 and with 200 yes-or-no answers, |measured - predicted| share kept, median over the units, is at most 0.07

Y4.rule: with 5,000 yes-or-no answers the share kept is in the median at least 0.9

added_after_the_results.why: bias left with yes and no = kappa / (n (1 + B)^2): the slope is needed in units of the judge's whole noise, and the same estimate sets the unit
